Posts in this `research` folder appear automatically in the feed on the
[Research](/research.qmd) page, because their folder is `posts/research/`
and their `categories:` field starts with `research` (the controlled,
page-mapping tag). Any further tags in `categories:` — here, `food webs` —
are freeform topic tags.

Because this is a `.qmd` file, R code runs when the site is rendered — by
GitHub Actions on every push. For example, a simple logistic population
growth curve, the kind of prediction problem the group works on:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true"}
r <- 0.3     # intrinsic growth rate
K <- 500     # carrying capacity
N0 <- 10     # initial population size
t <- 0:40

N <- K / (1 + ((K - N0) / N0) * exp(-r * t))

plot(t, N, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#0028A5",
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population size",
     main = "Logistic growth")
```
